_comment: Czech basic foods mapped onto USDA FoodData Central (SR Legacy / Foundation) descriptions. scripts/build_basic_seed.py resolves each entry against the official USDA CSV release and writes seed/basic_foods.json with the fdc_id and the nutrient values. Entries not found in USDA are skipped.
